_: tal-draw config for the matrix horizontal-rule registry test (tree-hz-clade-lines.json).
_1: Clades sit to the RIGHT of the matrix (clades_before_time_series false = AD layout-tree-only), which is the report-tree layout where a clade rule and an hz separator overlap across the whole matrix.
_2: Clade P covers L3..L5 (verticals 2..4) -> rules above vertical 2 and above vertical 5; clade Q covers L7 (vertical 6) -> rules above vertical 6 and above vertical 7.
_3: H1 is deliberately clear of every clade boundary (rules above verticals 0 and 1). H2 matches clade P exactly, H3 matches clade Q exactly, and H4 both abuts H3 (its top rule is H3's bottom rule) and ends on the LAST leaf, whose bottom rule AD cannot register (Node::last_next_leaf is null there).
